items.source_en:
PART I
Once, in a peaceful meadow, there lived a herd of happy groats cared for by a kind shepherd.

One afternoon, the shepherd led the groats to graze near a deep ravine filled with thick, tangled brush. The groats were happily munching on grass when they strayed too far, suddenly finding themselves lost and trapped in the dense thicket.

The groats bleated in panic, unsure of what to do. The shepherd's calls were faint and distant, and the path back home was hidden by the thick brush.

1부
평화로운 초원에서, 친절한 목자가 돌봐줘서 행복한 그로트 무리가 살고 있었습니다.

어느 날 오후, 목자는 그로트 떼를 이끌고 덤불이 무성하게 엉킨 깊은 계곡 근처로 풀을 먹이러 갔습니다. 행복하게 풀을 뜯고 있던 그로트 떼들은, 너무 멀리 벗어나 갑자기 길을 잃고 울창한 덤불에 갇히게 되었습니다.
